title: Evaluating Language Models in Realistic Conversational Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2608.26131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to serve open-ended, multi-turn interactions, evaluating conversational quality at human scale has become a central challenge. Existing evaluation frameworks built for summarization, translation, or short-form QA tasks fall short of adequately measuring the consistency of human-scale dialogue, especially when derivation and validation of these metrics themselves often rely on synthetic rather than human sources. We fill the gap by introducing UPHELD (UPwork Human-Scale Evaluated Long Dialogues), a large, reference-full benchmark for evaluating human-scale conversational ability beyond factual correctness. translated_title: 在现实对话情境中评估语言模型
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署用于开放式、多轮交互，以人类规模评估对话质量已成为一个核心挑战。现有的针对摘要、翻译或短问答任务构建的评估框架，不足以充分衡量人类规模对话的一致性，尤其是当这些指标本身的推导和验证往往依赖于合成数据而非人类来源时。我们通过引入UPHELD（Upwork人类规模评估的长对话）来填补这一空白，这是一个大型、带参考的基准测试集，用于评估超越事实正确性的人类规模对话能力。UPHELD包含数百个由专业编剧创作的完整人机对话，具有现实的回合密度，并在30,000多个专家生成的对话回合中提供了36,000多条逐回合人类标注。利用UPHELD，我们系统地评估了经典自动评估方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一个名为UPHELD的大型基准测试集，包含专业编剧创作的真实人类对话和大量人工标注，用于填补现有评估框架在衡量大型语言模型人类规模对话能力方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UPHELD, a large benchmark with professional human dialogues and extensive human annotations, to fill the gap in evaluating large language models' human-scale conversational ability beyond factual correctness.
